create_OnlinePearsonCorr_metric: create an OnlinePearsonCorr metric to compute online Pearson correlation coefficients with configurable dimension and reduction
use_Rank_compute_sim: use the Rank class to compute cosine similarity scores between two sets of embeddings with configurable normalization
compute_ranks_with_labels: compute ranking scores for predicted embeddings against ground truth labels using the Rank metric class
use_TopkAcc_metric: use the TopkAcc metric to measure top-k accuracy for embedding retrieval tasks with configurable k value
compute_topk_scores: compute top-k nearest neighbor labels and scores for query embeddings against a candidate set
